# DocInspector

> DocInspector is a free, privacy-first online PDF toolkit. All processing happens client-side in the browser — no files are uploaded to any server. No registration required.

DocInspector provides professional-grade PDF tools accessible directly in the browser. It also offers a downloadable desktop application for Windows/Mac/Linux for offline use.

## Key Features

- **100% Private**: Files never leave the user's device. All PDF operations run locally in the browser using WebAssembly.
- **Free**: All tools are free to use, no account required.
- **Batch Processing**: Most tools support processing multiple files simultaneously.
- **Multilingual**: Available in English, Romanian, and Russian.

## Online PDF Tools

- [Encrypt PDF Online](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/encrypt-pdf-online) — Password protect PDF files, restrict printing/copying/editing permissions.
- [Add Watermark to PDF](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/add-watermark-pdf-online) — Add custom text watermarks to single or multiple PDFs.
- [Redact PDF Online](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/redact-pdf-online) — Permanently black out sensitive text and images in PDFs.
- [Sanitize PDF Metadata](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/sanitize-pdf-metadata) — Remove hidden metadata (author, creation date, software info) from PDFs.
- [Flatten PDF Online](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/flatten-pdf-online) — Flatten form fields and annotations into permanent content.
- [Repair PDF Online](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/repair-pdf-online) — Fix corrupted or broken PDF files.
- [PDF Bundle Summary](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/pdf-bundle-summary-online) — Generate a summary report (borderou) for a collection of PDF documents.
- [Advanced PDF Bundle Report](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/advanced-pdf-bundle-report) — Detailed analysis and reporting for PDF document bundles.
- [Remove PDF Signatures](https://doc-inspector.com/en/tools/remove-pdf-signatures) — Strip digital signatures from PDF files.

## All Tools Hub

- [Document Metadata Leaks](https://doc-inspector.com/en/blog/document-metadata-leaks) — Why hidden PDF metadata is a privacy risk.

## Desktop Application

DocInspector is also available as a downloadable desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides offline access to all tools with the same privacy guarantees.

## Use Cases

- Legal professionals redacting sensitive documents before sharing
- Accountants and businesses creating document bundle reports (borderou)
- Privacy-conscious users removing metadata before sending PDFs
- HR and compliance teams encrypting confidential documents
- IT professionals flattening and sanitizing PDFs for archival
